voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.16 s, atempo 1.07 to fit 60 s; take 2 (the shorter); two sentences left out for time

lines.text: Two in the morning, coming down the ghat road, there was something in my mirror. On all fours. And it was keeping up.
lines.beat_before: hook: the cabin camera, through the back window, red in the tail lights: something on all fours on the road behind, gaining

lines.text: An hour before, on a bend above the village, a woman in a shawl had waved me down.
lines.beat_before: the front dashcam: the ghat road, switchbacks, pines, the crash barrier; a figure on the bend waving

lines.text: She walked into my headlights, and I saw her feet. The heels were at the front. Her toes pointed back, down the road.
lines.beat_before: the taxi slows; she walks into the headlights; her feet: heels forward, toes back (the viewer sees it first)

lines.text: I didn't stop. I put my foot down. I hit her.
lines.beat_before: I floor it; she stands in the beam; the impact: the windscreen cracks, blood across it

lines.text: In the camera, she gets up. The bones of her shins are through the skin. Her knees bend backwards. And she runs.
lines.beat_before: the cabin camera through the back window: she lies in the red light; bones through her shins; her knees bend backwards; she rises and runs

lines.text: Sixty. Seventy. Eighty, on a mountain road. I looked left. She was at my window, keeping pace.
lines.beat_before: the speed climbs; the cabin camera: at the passenger window, keeping pace, hair streaming

lines.text: The old drivers call her the chudail. They say never stop for her, and never look back.
lines.beat_before: the front dashcam: she is gone; the road; dawn coming up over the ridge, the town below

lines.text: Then I watched the cabin camera. All the way down, a hand was resting on the back of my seat.
lines.beat_before: the cabin camera at dawn, played back: me driving, alone; a pale hand with long nails resting on the top of my seat
